title: IsoGraph brain analysis: IsoGraph separates transcript-usage and abundance contributions to aging brain networks
description: Version 1.1.0 of the analysis and benchmarking repository accompanying IsoGraph separates transcript-usage and abundance contributions to aging brain networks (Cell Genomics submission). Adds the joint-matched long-read null and its pinned local runner, long-read confirmation of module driver switches, the redrawn Fig. 6a, a set-level sheet in Data S21, and supplementary items renumbered by first citation. Includes analysis code, configurations, environment snapshots, figure and table builders, and tracked result artifacts. Original code: Apache-2.0; original derived data, figures and documentation: CC-BY-4.0. Third-party resources retain their original terms. Large ignored intermediates are intended for a separate data deposit.
